posts.title: From Forests to Ice: How BIOMASS Reads the Earth
posts.description: BIOMASS is an ESA mission designed to improve global estimates of forest biomass and carbon stocks by using a P-band SAR radar, whose long wavelength allows the signal to penetrate vegetation and interact with large structural elements such as trunks and major branches. posts.title: Ports of Departure of the Global Sumud Flotilla
posts.description: Satellite imagery acquired by Sentinel-1C and Sentinel-2 provides a detailed view of the ports from which the Global Sumud Flotilla (https://globalsumudflotilla.org/) is scheduled to depart: Genoa (Italy), Barcelona (Spain), Tunis (Tunisia), and Sicily (Italy).
